title: Favourable Missingness in Semi-Supervised Classification for Exponential Mixture Models
summary: Semi-supervised classifiers are commonly trained from samples in which all features are observed but some class labels are missing. When label missingness is independent of the observed data, unavailable class memberships reduce Fisher information relative to a completely classified sample. We study a different regime in which the probability of label missingness depends on posterior classification uncertainty, so that the observed missing-label indicators can themselves carry information about the Bayes decision boundary.
